summary_hint: which servicer holds the borrower's existing mortgage on which property, the current balance and scheduled payment, the delinquency status and 30/60/90 late counts

typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity — confirms this is a VOM

typed_core.name: property_address
typed_core.why: identity — which property the lien is on (degraded from address)

typed_core.name: mortgage_holder_or_servicer
typed_core.why: identity — the servicer certifying the loan (the source)
typed_core.prompt_hint: A VOM is servicer-certified; read the servicer (holder) as the source and the verifier as the signing representative

typed_core.name: borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — the mortgagor; attaches to the borrower (flattened from person[])

typed_core.name: borrower_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — co-borrower when present (flattened)

typed_core.name: loan_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII + identity/dedup — the existing loan's masked number

typed_core.name: origination_date
typed_core.why: processor — loan vintage/seasoning

typed_core.name: original_loan_amount
typed_core.why: processor — original balance for LTV/pay-down context

typed_core.name: loan_type
typed_core.why: processor — conventional/FHA/VA affects treatment (degraded from enum)

typed_core.name: interest_rate
typed_core.why: processor — note rate on the existing loan (degraded from percent)

typed_core.name: maturity_date
typed_core.why: processor — remaining term of the obligation

typed_core.name: current_principal_balance
typed_core.why: processor — current payoff/obligation

typed_core.name: scheduled_monthly_payment
typed_core.why: processor — the DTI housing payment

typed_core.name: principal_and_interest_payment
typed_core.why: disambiguator — P&I vs full PITI; without it scheduled_monthly_payment is ambiguous

typed_core.name: escrow_payment
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the escrow (T&I) portion beside the P&I

typed_core.name: next_payment_due_date
typed_core.why: processor — current standing (paid-through date)

typed_core.name: taxes_and_insurance_current
typed_core.why: processor — escrowed T&I current indicator (degraded from boolean)

typed_core.name: late_30_count
typed_core.why: processor — number of 30-day lates (housing history 0x30 test) (flattened from late_payment_counts object)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Housing-history convention: "0x30" means zero 30-day lates in the window; the goal is the count of each late bucket, not prose

typed_core.name: late_60_count
typed_core.why: processor — number of 60-day lates (flattened)

typed_core.name: late_90_count
typed_core.why: processor — number of 90+-day lates (flattened)

typed_core.name: current_delinquency_status
typed_core.why: processor — headline current/delinquent status (degraded from enum)

typed_core.name: past_due_amount
typed_core.why: processor — amount currently past due

typed_core.name: foreclosure_or_loss_mitigation_status
typed_core.why: processor — active FC/loss-mit is a material adverse signal (degraded from enum)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Loss-mitigation/forbearance/modification flags are material — capture them even when they appear only as a checkbox or a one-line note

typed_core.name: forbearance_or_modification_terms
typed_core.why: processor — a mod/forbearance changes how the payment history reads (flattened from object)

typed_core.name: verifier_name_title
typed_core.why: processor — who at the servicer certified (authority)

typed_core.name: verifier_phone_or_contact
typed_core.why: processor — servicer callback (degraded from phone)

typed_core.name: verification_date
typed_core.why: identity/recency — certification date

typed_core.name: direct_source_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — whether it came directly from the servicer (independence) (degraded from boolean)

nested_lists.name: payment_history_months
nested_lists.shape_reason: monthly payment history genuinely repeats and a VOM often spans 12-24 months, so flat rows keep it under the 16,384 ceiling

fields.name: payment_status
fields.why: paid/late/delinquent status for the month; corroborates the late-bucket counts

rejected.name: form_number / form_revision_date
rejected.reason: VOM templates vary; no standardized-form consumer

rejected.name: statement_period_start / statement_period_end
rejected.reason: a VOM is a certification, not a statement period

rejected.name: loan_number
rejected.reason: duplicates loan_number_masked (the restricted, masked form is the one to keep)

rejected.name: other_payment_components
rejected.reason: object[] with no consumer; P&I + escrow already capture the split

rejected.name: escrow_balance
rejected.reason: OPTIONAL; no consumer (next_payment_due_date + taxes_and_insurance_current carry standing)

rejected.name: signature_blocks / notary_block / document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: execution captured by verifier + direct_source_indicator; a VOM is not notarized

encoding_variations: Scheduled payment ambiguity: some VOMs report P&I only, others full PITI — always pair scheduled_monthly_payment with principal_and_interest_payment and escrow_payment so the composition is unambiguous

Late counts appear as a grid ("30-day: 2, 60-day: 0, 90-day: 0"), as a rating string ("0x30"), or embedded in the payment-history months — read the grid into the three scalar counts and let the month rows corroborate
Delinquency status stated as "Current", "Paid as agreed", or a code — capture the label; a future rule normalizes it

open_questions.q: loan_number_masked registration + policy — needs adding to _PII_FIELDS (pre_masked=true).
open_questions.recommendation: confirm whether VOMs in practice arrive pre-masked or need extractor-side masking

open_questions.q: late_payment_counts flattening — flattened to late_30/60/90 scalar ints assuming the fixed Fannie/Freddie 30/60/90 buckets.
options: add a fourth field for other buckets (120+, worst rating)
open_questions.recommendation: if servicers report other buckets (120+, "worst rating"), the shape may need a fourth field; flag for a real-sample check

options: trim interest_rate/loan_type/maturity_date first if a reviewer wants to shrink
open_questions.recommendation: keep all — a VOM carries both the full existing-obligation terms (for DTI) and the delinquency history (for housing performance), two distinct consumer groups; trim interest_rate/loan_type/maturity_date first if a reviewer wants to shrink

notes: No rules read this document today (rule floor is empty); fields are justified by identity, disambiguation, PII, and processor use. A VOM is a servicer-certified record of an existing mortgage; its value is the housing-payment history (0x30 vs delinquencies) and the current obligation for DTI.

loan_number_masked is restricted sensitivity and NOT in the 7-field _PII_FIELDS registry (the registered account_number_masked is a different field); needs registration, pre_masked=true (mask to last-4 in the extractor if a full number appears).
late_payment_counts is flattened to three scalar counts (a fixed 30/60/90 object, not a repeating list).
